production: No implementation/design counterexample was demonstrated by the generated campaign. Controls establish the sensitivity of the tested boundaries, not correctness of the whole protocol.
unitRerun: An initial full unit suite overlapped three browser campaigns and the 150-history spool property hit its existing five-second limit without a counterexample. The unchanged suite was rerun after browser completion, with its original timeout retained. Both logs are preserved.

fixtureRepair.failure: The first source-retention assertion required the entire capsule list to stay identical after cold open. Reopening produced an additional empty Yjs update capsule (bytes 0,0).
fixtureRepair.repair: Check that every original capsule survives byte-for-byte, by its authenticated identity, while allowing new captures.

controls: Return-before-persistence exposes signed bytes without a saved submission.
Omitting witness verification allows a missing final closure to reopen ready and expose the prior submission again.
Omitting prefix contradiction checks classifies contradictory proofs as closed in both orders; the real reader derives conflict from those same retained proofs.
Omitting authority rechecks commits a submission after the test restores a prior authenticated v7 marker while device signing is paused.

propositions.oracle: Independent set-based prefix, closure and final-cutoff propositions, checked at each step and in reverse order.

native.length: 3..6 answers after a submission commit fault
native.oracle: Independent Node/OpenSSL signed responses, durable record-count and proof propositions; exact retry, pending eligibility, retained source identities and wire across cold restart and optional compaction.

boundary: V8 first-epoch private lifecycle only. All source and ledger rows retained. Closure/conflict/finalization halt outbound work while Local editing stays available. Full scans and coordinated metadata+ledger rollback remain limits. No transport, service permanence, successor minting, lineage advancement or personal Account provisioning.
wiring: account:delivery added to pnpm check before all final campaigns. Direct Node entrypoints were run; no whole pnpm check execution is claimed.
